_comment: Blessed local-machine MCP client config for arifOS. Remote works immediately; local requires arifOS runtime on 127.0.0.1:8088.

arifos-remote._comment: Recommended default for Copilot and any MCP client with remote streamable-http support.

arifos-local._comment: Use when this machine runs uv run python -m arifosmcp.runtime.server.
